name: 14604 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14604 (Rochester) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14604 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14604 (Rochester) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 16.1 times the typical level).
